# Watch the Night

Watch the Night is a citizen skywatch gear guide: telescopes, binoculars, star trackers and accessories for people who want to look at the night sky themselves — and capture what they see.

## Picks

- [Celestron NexStar 8SE](https://watchthenight.com/gear/celestron-nexstar-8se/) — The computerized 8-inch that finds it for you.
- [Apertura AD8 8" Dobsonian](https://watchthenight.com/gear/apertura-ad8-dobsonian/) — Maximum aperture per dollar. Point and sweep.
- [Celestron StarSense Explorer DX 130AZ](https://watchthenight.com/gear/celestron-starsense-explorer-dx-130az/) — Your phone guides you to 100+ targets.
- [Sky-Watcher Star Adventurer 2i](https://watchthenight.com/gear/skywatcher-star-adventurer-2i/) — Turn any camera into a deep-sky rig.
- [Celestron SkyMaster 15x70](https://watchthenight.com/gear/celestron-skymaster-15x70/) — The cheapest serious sky upgrade.

- [Sky-Watcher Heritage 150P](https://watchthenight.com/gear/skywatcher-heritage-150p/) — 6 inches of tabletop Dobsonian — the sweet spot starter scope.

- [Canon EOS Rebel T7](https://watchthenight.com/gear/canon-eos-rebel-t7/) — The default budget astrophotography DSLR.

- [Canon EF 50mm f/1.8 STM](https://watchthenight.com/gear/canon-ef-50mm-f18-stm/) — The nifty fifty — the cheapest way into tracked Milky Way shots.
- [ZWO Seestar S50](https://watchthenight.com/gear/zwo-seestar-s50/) — The all-in-one smart scope — it finds, tracks, and stacks for you.
